create.about_roll:
Assign the standard values (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8) to your abilities.
They start with your class's recommended layout.
To swap, pick the first ability (marked ◆), then pick the one to swap it with.
create.about_point_buy: Every score starts at 8. Spend 27 points with Left/Right (or left/right click inside the left panel) to raise or lower the selected score (max 15).
create.about_skills: Choose the skills your class gains.
create.about_freeabilities: Choose the ability scores to get +1 (Half-Elf).
create.about_alignment: Alignment is part of your character's personality. For now it does not change choices in battle or events, and it does not affect strength.
create.hint: Up/Down to pick, Enter to confirm / Cancel to go back one step
party.empty: No party (create characters at the Training Grounds, then add them under Party at the Clan House)
town.title: The Town Above
town.confirm_quit: Save and return to the title?
town.about_tavern:
Listen to the patrons' rumors. You may hear of named foes in the maze, or news from town.

* Form your party under Party at the Clan House.
town.about_temple_sure: Resurrect dead companions, or cure poison, paralysis and more. On this difficulty, resurrection always succeeds.
town.about_inn: Stay the night and take a long rest. HP, spell slots and class feature uses are restored. The party's gold pays for it.
town.about_shop: Buy and sell gear and items, identify items, and remove curses. Purchases are paid from party gold; sale proceeds are shared.
town.about_temple: Resurrect dead companions, or cure poison, paralysis and more. A failed resurrection turns the body to ashes, and failing again on ashes loses the character.
town.about_training: Create, inspect, level up, rename or delete characters.
town.about_maze: Enter the maze with your party. The up stairs on B1 lead back to town.
town.about_maze_no_party: You need a party that can act to enter the maze. Create characters at the Training Grounds, then add them under Party at the Clan House.
town.about_quit: Save and return to the title screen.
tavern.about_main:
Listen to the patrons' rumors.

* Form your party under Party at the Clan House.
inn.about: The party's gold pays for the stay. How much HP comes back depends on the room. Spell slots and class feature uses come back in any room.
inn.stable_about: Sleep on straw. HP recovers to half.
inn.room_about: Rest in a bed. HP fully recovers.
training.about: Create a new character or pick one from the roster. When you have enough XP, you can level up here.
style.none: None (no effect with your current gear)

passive.about.style_great_weapon: Reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed weapon damage
passive.about.style_two_weapon: Add your ability modifier to off-hand attacks
feature.about.breath_weapon: Breathe fire on a nearby enemy group (Dexterity save for half). 2d6, 3d6 at level 6, 4d6 at 11, 5d6 at 16. Recharges on a short rest.
status.close_pages_members: Left/Right: page   L2/R2, < >, F1-F6: other member   Confirm / Cancel: close

combat.enemy_surprised: The enemy has not noticed you yet!
feature.about.second_wind: Catch your breath and regain 1d10 + fighter level HP. It is a bonus action, so you also attack that turn.
feature.about.action_surge: Take the Attack action twice in a row.
feature.about.rage: Rage and attack (recharges on a long rest). For this battle, Strength melee damage rises and you take half bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. No spellcasting, and concentration ends. From level 2 your melee attacks have advantage, but so do attacks against you.
feature.about.lay_on_hands: Touch an ally and restore HP from your pool (curing poison costs 5).
feature.about.divine_smite: Attack; the first melee hit spends a spell slot for extra radiant damage.
feature.about.flurry_of_blows: Spend 1 ki to make two unarmed strikes after attacking.
feature.about.patient_defense: Spend 1 ki to attack and then take the Dodge action.
feature.about.stunning_strike: Attack; the first hit spends 1 ki to stun the target (Constitution save).
feature.about.turn_undead: Turn all undead (Wisdom save). Weak undead are destroyed.
feature.about.bardic_inspiration: Give an ally an inspiration die, added when an attack or save would fail. It is a bonus action, so you also use an attack cantrip or attack that turn.
feature.about.wild_shape: Take a beast's form. You fight with the beast's HP and AC and return when its HP runs out or the battle ends. No items while transformed, and no spells below level 18.

combat.about.dodge: Until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage. It doesn't reduce damage.
combat.about.help: Choose an ally. Their next attack has advantage (it doesn't heal).
combat.about.hide: Make a Stealth check against the enemies' perception. On a success, enemies are less likely to target you and your next attack has advantage.
combat.about.swap: Swap places in the formation with an ally (uses this turn's action).
combat.about.flee: The whole party flees. If this character passes a Dexterity check, the battle ends (harder with more enemies nearby).
combat.about.auto: Pick actions automatically for allies who haven't chosen yet and start the round (chosen actions stay).
combat.about.auto_nospell: Pick actions for allies who haven't chosen yet without spells or class features, and start the round (chosen actions stay).

pick.about.cantrips: Cantrips use no slots and can be cast any number of times. You learn more as you level up. You can change them at the Training Grounds at any time.
pick.about.known: Cast the spells you know, within your slots. Wizards prepare from the spells written in their spellbook. You can change them at the Training Grounds at any time.
pick.about.prepared: Cast your prepared spells, within your slots. You can change preparations in town or at camp at any time.
training.spellbook: Choose spells to write in the spellbook

camp.about: Rest in the maze and get your spells and status in order.
camp.about_rest: Rest for an hour. Spend Hit Dice to recover HP; warlocks regain spell slots. Each member who can act studies one unidentified item and learns what it is. Enemies may come while you rest.
camp.about_prepare: Change prepared spells (Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Wizard).

chest.title: Chest
chest.about_inspect: Inspect: d20 + Intelligence modifier + Investigation proficiency. On a failure you may believe it's a different trap, and a natural 1 sets it off.
chest.about_disarm: Disarm: choose the trap's name; a wrong guess sets it off. If right, d20 + Dexterity modifier (plus proficiency if you carry thieves' tools and are proficient). Missing by 5 or more sets it off.
chest.about_open: Open as is: a trap goes off 90% of the time. A trap that drops you to 0 HP kills you, with no death saves.
chest.inspect_triggered: {0} set off the trap while inspecting!
chest.item_left: {0} won't fit in the pack and was left behind.

maze.enter_dark_lit: You entered darkness, but a light shows the way.
lock.about_pick: Pick: the chosen character must carry thieves' tools (another member's tools don't count). d20 + Dexterity modifier (plus proficiency if proficient).
lock.about_knock: Knock: uses your lowest available slot and always opens the lock.
lock.about_kick: Kick: d20 + Strength modifier + Athletics proficiency. On a failure, the noise may bring enemies.

lock.kick_failed: {0} kicked the door, but it held.

elevator.about: Travel to any floor you have visited.

maze.pit_feather: A pit! But you float gently down.
boss.final.intro: In the dark at the very bottom, something turns to face you. The master of this dungeon.
boss.final.victory: The master of the depths falls. On the altar beyond, what it guarded remains.
ending.1:
The master of the depths has fallen,
and the lowest floor is quiet.
ending.2:
Seeing what you brought back, the townsfolk
at last stop ringing the night bell.

ai.title: AI Settings
ai.paste_bad: The clipboard has no Claude API key (text starting with sk-ant-). Copy it first, then choose this.
ai.saved: The key is stored in Windows Credential Manager.

ai.about: With a Claude API key, the AI writes text for each new world when you start a new game: a prologue, floor names and the lines shown on entering them, and writings found in the dungeon. The story, monsters, treasure and dungeon layout do not change. The text is saved, so loading never calls the AI again. It is called once per new game and Anthropic charges for it. "Test connection" also makes a small AI call, which is charged.
ai.about_key: The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager, never in the options or saves. Without a key, or when the AI cannot be reached, the game uses its built-in text.
